from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4a8f1c81.py')

code='''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    anchor = grid[0][0]
    colors = []
    for row in grid[1:]:
        c = row[0]
        if c != bg and c not in colors:
            colors.append(c)
    seq = [anchor] + list(reversed(colors))
    return [[seq[r % len(seq)] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code)
test=[[5]*9,[0]*9,[2]*9,[1]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9,[0]*9,[9]*9]
out=transform(test)
print(out)
